products.name: GE Voluson E10 Ultrasound Scanner
products.shortDesc: High-end women's health radiology and maternity scans with HDlive silhouette rendering.
products.description: The GE Voluson E10 is the leading high-frequency diagnostic ultrasound system designed for obstetrics, gynecology, and cutting-edge fetal cardiology. Sporting an advanced Radiance System Architecture, it unlocks peerless image resolutions and ultra-fast frame rates for dynamic 4D rendering.
features: Advanced 4D Matrix scanning arrays
HDlive visual silhouette rendering for extreme clinical clarity
OLED diagnostic displays with high-contrast color gamut
Raw data review capabilities with immediate archive transfer

products.name: Dräger Primus Anesthesia Station
products.shortDesc: Advanced ventilation and gas delivery workstation supporting neonates to adults.
products.description: Dräger Primus is synonymous with operating room versatility and safety. Providing excellent ventilation and anesthesiology monitoring solutions, it features fully electronic gas mixing systems with rapid reaction times that simplify general surgical workflows under high strain.
features: E-Vent plus electronically driven piston ventilator
Heated patient respiratory system avoids condensation issues
Advanced gas delivery with synchronized vaporizers
Fully dynamic color display showing compliance curves

products.name: Philips IntelliVue MX450 Bedside Monitor
products.shortDesc: Multi-parameter high acuity monitor featuring comprehensive cardiac analysis.
products.description: IntelliVue MX450 delivers highly accurate real-time bedside monitoring for intensive care environments. Supporting multiple physiological modules (ECG, SpO2, Temp, IBP, CO2), this system guarantees high data fidelity and integrates securely with medical health record systems.
features: Stunning touch UI panel with adjustable illumination sensors
IntelliVue proprietary waveform analysis filters noise
Advanced cardiac arrhythmia tracking parameters
Wireless LAN linkages to central nursing stations

specifications.Parameters: ECG, Respiration, SpO2, NIBP, Dual Temp, Dual IBP
specifications.Mounting: Bedside Safety Clamp / Roll Stand Mountable

products.name: AeroMed Ventilator Pro-7
products.shortDesc: State-of-the-art invasive & non-invasive lung ventilator with automated weaning filters.
products.description: AeroMed Pro-7 is a critical care ventilator that adapts intuitively to the patient's respiratory needs. With sophisticated trigger thresholds and integrated high-flow oxygen therapy capabilities, this ventilator maintains clinical control and reduces the risks of patient distress.
features: Invasive and Non-Invasive (NIV) ventilation profiles
Dynamic lung visualizer depicting anatomical compliance
Integrated high flow oxygen therapy (HFNC) module
Ultra-silent internal turbine compressor avoids external gas dependency

products.name: Belimed MST-V Steam Autoclave
products.shortDesc: High-volume steam sterilizer with digital sterilization validation trackers.
products.description: Belimed MST-V delivers optimal sterilization parameters for clinical tools and surgical kits. Combining efficient water conservation tech with double door safety layouts, this sterilizer streamlines CSSD room workflows while exceeding international safety protocols.
features: Energy savings with internal water-recycling vacuum pumps
Automated pneumatic sliding doors with obstruction optical sensors
Built-in batch printer and USB logging parameters
Chamber lining crafted from pure premium grade 316Ti stainless steel

products.name: Olympus EVIS EXERA III Video Scope
products.shortDesc: Premium HDTV Gastrointestinal endoscopic system with Narrow Band Imaging.
products.description: The EVIS EXERA III gastrointestinal scope introduces medical facilities to ultra-high-definition imaging scopes. Harnessing high intensity optical filters, it assists physicians in locating minimal tissue anomalies on early stage diagnosis workflows.
features: Dual-Focus mechanics allowing deep-field zoom controls
Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) triples capillaries visualization contrast
Responsive insertion tubes reduce patient tissue friction and pain
Full waterproofing housing enables comprehensive chemical reprocessing
